item.tib: mdo sde me tog phreng ba'i dbang chog rin po che tog gi nor bu 'bar ba
item.coloph: zhes pa'ang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi mdo las rjes 'jug byin rlabs zhu thabs/ dbang chog rin po che tog gi nor bu 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di/ mtshungs med gsang sngags grags pa'i (pa) rig 'dzin chen pos 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 'chi med yab sras kyi rjes 'brang gsang ba sngags la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor b+ho d+hi hri d+ha zhes pa'am/ u rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas gdan sar smin grol khrod kyi bla brang yang rtser dge sbyor thun mtshams su shar mar spel ba'o/ /de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs bcu kun du dar zhing rgyas gnas par gyur cig/
